properties.name: Samut Songkhram coastal provisional AOI
properties.purpose: Initial satellite search/clip AOI covering Samut Songkhram coast, Mae Klong river mouth, Don Hoi Lot/intertidal zone and adjacent reference coast. Replace with verified SEG030/planting polygons when available.
